families.label: Cross detection and signal correctness
families.rationale: Positional alignment, T-1 timing, and the three-day cross window are covered by correctness tests and the adopted mainline.

families.label: Additional technical-indicator enumeration
families.rationale: RSI, MACD, KDJ, BOLL, MA, ADX/DMI, volume, CMF, BandWidth, and Kaufman ER already cover reversal, trend, location, flow, volatility, and efficiency. Trying more indicators now would be winner selection after repeated tests.

families.label: Indicator periods and score thresholds
families.rationale: Coarse buy, sell, hold, RSI, ADX, ATR, and capacity variants have been tested. Fine searches around the winners are prohibited parameter mining.

families.label: Entry confirmation and backup fills
families.rationale: Volume, trend, weak-entry sizing, low-bounce blocking, backup fills, cross sequence, and gap filters did not produce stable training evidence.

families.label: Signal exits and ATR risk controls
families.rationale: Sell thresholds, minimum holds, structure protection, replacement awareness, profit tightening, cooldowns, and ATR multiplier changes have already been tested.

families.label: Position sizing and idle-capital deployment
families.rationale: Base exposure, volume scaling, weak-signal scaling, strong-trend extra capacity, and forced slot filling have been tested without robust improvement beyond the adopted sizing.

families.label: ETF deletion or selection from training attribution
families.rationale: Deleting ETFs from one training window showed path dependence and selection bias. Pool constituents must not be mined from 2019-2021 standalone contribution.

families.label: Candidate ranking with existing score components
families.rationale: Reversal, location, volume, trend, risk-adjusted, confirmation, and reversal-first rankings were tested; the last apparent gain came from one endpoint trade.

families.label: 09:35 execution gaps and timing filters
families.rationale: The pre-registered one-ATR gap split was sparse and directionally contradicted the chase-risk hypothesis. Smaller thresholds must not be searched post hoc.

families.label: Portfolio-level dependence and crowding
families.rationale: The single pre-registered 20-day/0.80 observation produced only 9 high-dependence trades. High dependence was profitable overall and strongly outperformed low dependence in 2020, so it is not a stable crowding filter. Do not search nearby windows or thresholds.

families.label: ETF-pool breadth regime
families.rationale: The single pre-registered MA20/50% observation reversed across years. Below-majority mild-trend entries had higher win rate in 2020 and materially better return and win rate in 2021, so breadth is not a stable universal entry filter.

families.label: ETF premium, quota, tracking, and cross-market microstructure
families.rationale: The one pre-registered 513100/513500 previous-NAV premium attribution found only two above-5% closed buys, both in 2020 and both in 513100. Sample-size, cross-year, and cross-code gates failed, so lower thresholds or wider QDII scopes are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized fixed MACD half-cycle comparison
families.rationale: The one fixed MACD(6,13,5) comparison was consumed. It cut local training return from 120.61% to 84.69% and worsened Sharpe, Sortino, win rate, profit/loss ratio, 2019, and 2021. Nearby period searches are prohibited.

families.label: User-authorized horizontal support and resistance structure
families.rationale: The fixed prior-20-day T-2-safe, one-ATR observation failed its annual gate. Near-resistance mild entries outperformed the comparison in 2019 and had higher win rate in 2021; all 89 closed buys were more than one ATR above prior support. Nearby periods, distances, pivots, and breakout rules are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized controlled-breakout anti-chase check
families.rationale: The one fixed observation found 15 controlled breakouts but only 2 extended breakouts: one in 2019, none in 2020, and one in 2021. The total and per-year sample gates failed, and the 2019 extended trade had a higher win rate than controlled breakouts. No candidate was permitted; nearby thresholds, periods, AND variants, breakout rewards, and sell changes are prohibited post-hoc searches.

families.label: User-authorized ETF shares-outstanding shadow diagnostic
families.rationale: A newly isolated primary-market shares-outstanding dataset provides an independent market-structure dimension not covered by price, volume, or technical-indicator enumeration. Exactly one sign-only five-observation attribution is authorized; it is observation-only and cannot change orders.
families.planned_experiment: Compare frozen cross-v0.3.2 closed upward-cross entries after positive versus non-positive log shares-outstanding change over exactly five trading observations, using only eligible domestic ETFs and neutralizing QDII, insufficient history, and registered split crossings.
